pages.title: Growth & Starter Pricing Decisions
pages.summary: Growth goes from $299 to $349 per location per month for new customers starting October 1, 2026.
pages.body:
- **2026-09-09** (Noor Haddad): Decision: Growth goes from $299 to $349 per location per month for new customers starting October 1, 2026. Existing customers keep $299 through March 31, 2027, then move to $349 at renewal.
- **2026-09-09** (Noor Haddad): Wren owns customer comms for the change. Tobias owns reissuing the pricing sheet by September 30.
- **2026-09-09** (Wren Castellano): On it. Keiko and I will send the grandfathering email to existing Growth accounts by September 22.
- **2026-09-11** (Wren Castellano): Marisol, can you own the HubSpot price book update? Due September 29.
- **2026-09-11** (Marisol Quint): Yes, I'll own it.
- **2026-09-12** (Noor Haddad): Correct. Starter stays at $149 for 2026. We'll revisit in the 2027 plan.
